title: Community college custodial RFP with inline building table grouped by campus (PDF)

sources.note: Polk State College RFP #16-03 Custodial Services, Scope of Work "List of Buildings to be used for Billing Purposes": rows copied verbatim (name + estimated gross SF): LTB – Technology Building 127,050; LAC – Academic Center 72,852; WRH – Rehabilitative Health 6,030; Seven (7) Modular Buildings – Winter Haven Campus 7,502; Chain of Lakes (COL) 14,540; CPS/ITB – Center for Public Safety Immersive Training Building 101,488; JD Alexander Center 16,143; Lake Wales Art(s) Center 12,422; four Lakeland modular buildings LMA/LMB/LMC/LMD 7,752. Also copied wording: "Floor plans and a list of rooms and square footage of each room is available for review at the Purchasing Department", per-SF monthly x 12 pricing by campus, payment reduced by SF taken out of service.

Executed contract for RFP #16-03: rows copied verbatim: WAD – Administration 47,863 and WCH – Club House 2,000 (billing list, estimated gross square footage); contract wording on relieving the contractor of obligations for areas taken out of service.
UAFS AX-24-003 Appendix 1: per-building APPA custodial service level column (AP2/AP3) — format only.
UCA RFP UCA-23-033: APPA Level 2 cleaning standard and building-by-building price-per-SF / monthly price form — format only.

provenance.notes: 11 of the 29 expected facility rows (WAD, WCH, WRH, Winter Haven modulars, COL, CPS/ITB, LTB, LAC, Lakeland modulars LMA-LMD, JD Alexander Center, Lake Wales Arts Center) carry names and gross SF copied from Polk State College RFP #16-03 and its contract, so the package is recognisably Polk-State-derived. The college name (Lakeridge State College) is a stand-in so that everything invented is not attributed to Polk State: the solicitation number, purchasing contact (555 telephone number), street addresses, the other 18 buildings and their SF (given generic names; the two invented centers no longer reuse real Polk State center names), floors, APPA levels, days of service, hours, Sections 3-4 (submission, evaluation points, insurance limits), and the current contract (Meridian Building Care, Inc., LSC-22-117, awarded April 2022, $2,186,400 per year). Floors are illustrative for every row. Sections 3-4 follow standard Florida College System RFP content (s. 287.133 public entity crimes, s. 448.095 E-Verify, s. 1012.465 Jessica Lunsford Act screening, s. 120.57(3) 72-hour protest window, Florida minimum wage $15.00 from September 30, 2026); the wording is written for this fixture.

traps: Campus subtotal rows (Winter Haven Campus Subtotal 440,633, Lakeland Campus Subtotal 336,849, Centers Subtotal 103,040) and the GRAND TOTAL – ALL LOCATIONS row (880,522) are not facilities.
Campus header rows ("WINTER HAVEN CAMPUS – 4100 Lake Region Boulevard ...") span the table and are not facilities.
The Section 5 Price Proposal Form repeats the campus subtotals and grand total as square footages; they must not be extracted as buildings or double counted.

WSC – Science Center (Renovation) shows "TBD – see Addendum" instead of a square footage; it is excluded from expected facilities (no SF to bill, not in the subtotal, footnote 3 says it shall not be priced until the Addendum is issued). A reader that emits it with a guessed or zero SF is counted as an extra.

Building code is embedded in the name cell with an en dash ("WAD – Administration"), in parentheses ("Chain of Lakes (COL)"), or as a slash code ("CPS/ITB – ..."); centers and modular groups have no code at all.

"CPS/ITB – Center for Public Safety Immersive Training Building", "WFO – Facilities Operations and Grounds Maintenance Shop" and "Flightline Aviation Center (Aerospace and Aviation Programs)" wrap to two lines inside the Building cell.

Grouped rows: "Seven (7) Modular Buildings – Winter Haven Campus" (7,502) and "Four (4) Modular Buildings – LMA, LMB, LMC, LMD" (7,752) are each one billing line; Section 2.3.3 says each group is billed as one line and individual modules are not separately listed or priced, and gives per-module sizes (960–1,124 SF; 1,938 SF each) for information only. Splitting the Lakeland group into LMA/LMB/LMC/LMD rows produces 3 extras and an SF mismatch.
Section 2.3.2 names facilities NOT included (WPE demolished June 2025, LCH cleaned by the school board, WEP central energy plant); none are expected.

Days of service codes map to service levels: M–F = daily_5, 7 days = daily_7, M/W/F = 3x_week, T/Th = 2x_week, 1x/wk = weekly. M–Sa (six days) has no exact service level, so truth omits serviceLevel for those rows.
Two-row table header (Cleaning spans APPA Level and Days of Service) and numeric APPA level column (1/2/3) sit next to the Floors column — a reader must not take the APPA level as floors.

Prior award is a narrative paragraph (Section 1.3): incumbent, contract number, award year (April 2022) and the current annual contract amount ($2,186,400, also given as $182,200 per month — the monthly figure is not the annual value). The contract period (July 1, 2022 – June 30, 2027) is stated but no total contract value is, so truth asserts annualValue only. The per-hour event-services rate and ~400 event hours are not part of it.

Distractor numbers in Sections 3-4 are not facilities or award values: evaluation points (25/20/15/5/35, total 100), insurance limits ($1,000,000 / $2,000,000 / $500,000 / $100,000), the $15.00 minimum wage, the 250,000 SF reference-account threshold and the 72-hour protest window.
Contract term is three years plus two one-year options = 5 contract years (Section 1.2); the prior contract's identical 3+2 structure in Section 1.3 is history, not the new term.

The running header ("Lakeridge State College – Purchasing Department | RFP #27-04 Custodial Services | Issued October 5, 2026") repeats on every page. Footnote markers sit on the table header text: a plain text layer (pdftotext) glues them on ("Footage1", "Level2", "Addendum3"); the app's layout reader marks them as [^1], [^2], [^3].
Mon–Sat (6-day) buildings are daily_6 (300 service days/yr), not daily_5 or daily_7.
